tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Default background of every section; `ink`, `ink-secondary` and `ink-muted` all read on it.

tokens.name: bg-wash
tokens.usage: Pink-tinted white used as a soft wash behind the hero and one supporting section per page (radial, fading to `bg`). `ink`, `ink-secondary`, `ink-muted` and `brand` text read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card and panel fill, always paired with a `border` hairline. Same text colors as `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet neutral fill: the active nav item, count badges, hover on rows, disabled fills. `ink`, `ink-secondary` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark charcoal tile / hero ground for high-contrast feature tiles and stat tiles. Text on it: `ink-inverse` and `ink-inverse-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-raised
tokens.usage: Gradient end for `surface-inverse` tiles (top-left `surface-inverse` to bottom-right `surface-inverse-raised`). Text: `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Solid brand fill for icon tiles, the Pill badge and the single highlighted stat tile. Text and glyphs on it: `on-brand`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, card titles, nav labels, form values. 18:1 or better on `bg`, `bg-wash`, `surface` and `surface-subtle`.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy, subcopy, descriptions. 6.4:1 on `bg`; above 5.5:1 on `bg-wash` and `surface-subtle`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, footer links, placeholders, inactive tab labels. 4.98:1 on `bg`, 4.66:1 on `bg-wash`, 4.57:1 on `surface-subtle`. Do not use on `red-50`, `red-100` or any dark surface.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast); never for anything a person must read.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`, `surface-inverse-raised` and photo scrims. 17:1 on `surface-inverse`, 11:1 on `surface-inverse-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-inverse` (11.5:1) and `surface-inverse-raised` (7.7:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand`, `brand-hover`, `brand-pressed`, `surface-brand`. 5.0:1 on `red-600`, 7:1 on `red-700`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards, dividers between rows (FAQ, footer), the nav pill outline. Decorative grouping only (about 1.3:1): never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on cards and quiet buttons; divider inside dense tables.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, selects, checkboxes: at least 3:1 on `bg`, `bg-wash` and `surface-subtle` so a control is findable without color.

tokens.name: border-brand
tokens.usage: Outline of the primary (outline) button and the selected chip ring. 5.0:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: border-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Border of the selected tab and tinted callouts, paired with `brand-soft` fill.

tokens.name: red-50
tokens.usage: Lightest red tint: tinted callout ground, hover ground on outline buttons. Text on it: `ink` or `red-700`.

tokens.name: red-100
tokens.usage: Selected tab / chip fill, count badge on a selected tab. Text on it: `red-700` (5.7:1) or `ink`; never `brand` (4.2:1).

tokens.name: red-200
tokens.usage: Third step of the chart ramp (`viz-5`), hover ground of selected chips. Decorative fills only.

tokens.name: red-400
tokens.usage: Coral: the end of the emphasis-gradient on headline text (`ink` to `red-400`), hero glow and arcs, second chart red. Decorative and 24px+ display text only (3.4:1 on `bg`).

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Saturated end of the dark page-banner gradient (`red-950` to `red-500`). Large white display text only (4.4:1).

tokens.name: red-600
tokens.usage: The brand red. Actions, eyebrows, links, active labels, icon tiles. 5.0:1 on `bg` and `bg-wash`; white on it 5.0:1.

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Deep red: hover for solid brand fills, wordmark, focus ring on light grounds, text on `red-100`. 7:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: red-800
tokens.usage: Pressed state; bottom end of the red feature-tile gradient (`red-600` to `red-800`).

tokens.name: red-900
tokens.usage: Dense dark red for deep panels and chart emphasis.

tokens.name: red-950
tokens.usage: Near-black maroon: start of the dark page-banner gradient, deepest hero ground.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Text and stroke colour for anything the person can act on or that marks where they are: outline-button label, text links, eyebrow labels, active nav label.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus-visible colour of `brand` text and solid brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Active (pressed) colour of solid brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Hover ground of outline buttons and tinted callouts.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tab, selected chip, selected row ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light grounds: 2px solid, 2px offset (`shadow-focus`). 7:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus ring on `surface-inverse`, photo tiles and `surface-brand`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: (derived) Text/icon of a positive status, always with a check icon and a word. 6.6:1 on `bg`, 6.0:1 on `success-bg`. Green is not in the reference; it is added because status needs a hue other than the brand red.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: (derived) Ground of a success alert or status chip.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: (derived) Border of a success alert.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: (derived) Text/icon of a caution status, always with a triangle icon and a word. 5.4:1 on `bg`, 5.0:1 on `warning-bg`.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: (derived) Ground of a warning alert or chip.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: (derived) Border of a warning alert.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: (derived) Text/icon of a failure. Because the brand is red, an error is never signalled by color alone: it carries an alert icon, the word 'Error' or a message, and a `error-bg` ground. 6.5:1 on `bg`, 5.8:1 on `error-bg`.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: (derived) Ground of an error alert or field message.

tokens.name: error-border
tokens.usage: (derived) Border of an error alert; the field border on error is `error` itself.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: (derived) Neutral slate for informational notes: no hue competes with the brand. 9.7:1 on `bg`, 8.6:1 on `info-bg`.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: (derived) Ground of an informational alert.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: (derived) Border of an informational alert.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: (derived) First chart series and the highlighted bar/line: the one that matters.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: (derived) Second series: charcoal, the strongest neutral.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: (derived) Third series and 'everything else' in a highlight chart.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: (derived) Fourth series; pair with a direct label, never a legend alone.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: (derived) Fifth series and range/confidence fills.

tokens.name: viz-grid
tokens.usage: (derived) Gridlines and axis rules in charts; lighter than `border`.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Downtime doesn't wait. Neither should you.
styles.usage: Hero headline and centered section titles. `ink`, with the emphasis gradient (`ink` to `red-400`) on the closing phrase.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Left-aligned section title beside media. One word may carry a 3px `brand` underline.

styles.name: heading-page
styles.usage: Page title inside the dark gradient banner, `ink-inverse`. Bolder than `heading-1` because it sits on a busy ground.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Feature-card title (may wrap to two lines on 32px leading). `ink`.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Segment/industry card title beneath its eyebrow. `ink`.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: List-item titles, accordion questions, tab labels. `ink`.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Enterprise-grade tooling, managed for you, without hiring an entire team.
styles.usage: Hero subcopy, accordion answers, footer descriptions. `ink-secondary`, 640px max measure.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Unified visibility across every site, before it becomes an incident.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: A short line that says what it does. And the promise.
styles.usage: Compact card descriptions and list-item descriptions. `ink-secondary`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrow and category label, set UPPERCASE (text-transform) in `brand`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Quiet uppercase label over a logo strip or group. `ink-muted`; wide tracking is the point.

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: Metric numerals on stat tiles, `ink-inverse`. Use tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) in tables and charts.

spacing.note: 4px base. Steps double roughly every two: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, with 20 and 40 for the two places the reference lands between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label micro gap, vertical badge padding, arrow nudge on hover.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon plus text in a link, chip internals, list of inline actions.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Dense grid gap (segment cards), card title to description, eyebrow to title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon tile to its text, field padding, subhead to body, section title to subcopy.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a button; row padding in accordions.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, default grid gap, gap between a card's text and its link.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero rhythm (headline, subcopy, button), gap between stacked blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Control height (buttons, inputs), large inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section header to content on compact sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section header to content on primary sections; footer top.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Default vertical section padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Major separation: hero to first section, feature bands.

radius.note: Soft but disciplined: buttons are rounded rectangles, never pills. Full round is reserved for status.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, checkbox, small inline highlights.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon tiles, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tabs, alerts, accordion focus area.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating nav bar, stat tiles, image tiles in the bento grid.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Framed hero/feature image and modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, count badges, status dots, avatars.

shadow.note: Almost flat. Surfaces are separated by hairlines, not shadows; only floating things (nav, menus, modals) lift.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating nav pill. Always combined with a `border` hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: (derived) Card hover lift and dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: (derived) Modals and popovers above a scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: The soft 4px ring that frames a feature image (image has its own 1px `border`).

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: (derived) Keyboard focus ring: white gap, then 2px `focus`. Use `focus-inverse` with a dark gap on inverse surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Atmospheric coral glow behind the hero object. One per page.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, nav outline, outline-button border.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selected-state emphasis, headline underline is 3px.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Stroke width of every outline icon at 20-24px.

container.note: Content widths. Everything centers; nothing hangs off the page edge except backgrounds and bleeds.

tokens.name: container-copy
tokens.usage: Max measure of centered subcopy and long paragraphs.

tokens.name: container-default
tokens.usage: Three-up card grids and centered content blocks.

tokens.name: container-nav
tokens.usage: The floating nav bar and page banners.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Split sections, dense segment grids, bento.

breakpoint.note: (derived) Minimum widths at which the layout steps up.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Two columns for card grids.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: nav shows links again; split sections go side by side.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Small desktop: three-up grids.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Full desktop: wide containers at intended widths.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Normal flow.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Floating nav bar, above scrolling content.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal and its scrim.
